::: {.section-intro}
If you might be interested in joining the team, welcome — below is some
general guidance on Masters, PhD, and postdoctoral opportunities. For who's
currently in the group and their research interests, see the
[People](people.qmd) page; get in touch with whoever's work looks like the
best fit (please read our
[advice on making an effective enquiry](posts/join-us/2019-03-03-making-an-effective-enquiry/index.qmd)
first).

Specific open positions, when there are any, are posted below (tag a post
`join-us`). Once a position is filled, add `archive` to its tags to take it
off this list — it stays visible on the [All posts](posts.qmd) page. If
nothing current fits, see [Contact](contact.qmd) for how to get in touch
anyway.
:::

## Masters

The group participates in the following graduate programmes:

- [Masters in Biology, Ecology](https://www.biologie.uzh.ch/de/Studium/Masterstudium/MasterStudies/Ecology.html)
- [Masters in Biology, Systematics and Evolution](https://www.biologie.uzh.ch/de/Studium/Masterstudium/MasterStudies/SystematicsEvolution.html)
- [Masters in Biology, Animal Behaviour](https://www.biologie.uzh.ch/de/Studium/Masterstudium/MasterStudies/AnimalBehaviour.html)
- [Masters in Environmental Sciences](https://www.ieu.uzh.ch/en/teaching/envsci/master.html)

## PhDs

Please contact a team member listed on the [People](people.qmd) page if
you have an idea for a PhD that fits with the group's research aims (and
please consider our
[advice about making an effective enquiry](posts/join-us/2019-03-03-making-an-effective-enquiry/index.qmd)
first). If you're interested in a PhD in Ecology (or a related subject),
UZH runs a strong ecology programme jointly with ETH — you can apply
directly, and may then be invited to Zurich to meet professors and groups
for a short interview, or you can apply directly to a professor. See
[the ecology PhD programme](https://www.ieu.uzh.ch/en/teaching/phd/graduate.html)
for more information, or, for PhDs in other areas of biology,
[the Life Sciences Zurich Graduate School](https://www.lifescience-graduateschool.uzh.ch/en.html).

## Postdocs

We're always happy to hear from motivated, enthusiastic postdoctoral
researchers whose interests fit well with the group's. Please contact a
team member listed on the [People](people.qmd) page (and, again, consider
our [advice about making an effective enquiry](posts/join-us/2019-03-03-making-an-effective-enquiry/index.qmd)
first).
